audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields claim Shen has no gap-closer 'until E at 6' or 'pre-6', and spikes[2].when is labelled 'Lvl 6+'.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is his E — available from level 3, often ranked earlier. Telling a player they are safe stepping up at level 4 or 5 is directly dangerous advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stand United's channel was never mentioned as interruptible.
audit.why: Shen's R shields an ally then teleports after a channel; any CC cancels it. Karma's Focused Resolve root is exactly that CC, and it lets a Karma alone in a side lane deny a cross-map save.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and the late-game text.

audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocking basic attacks — and therefore refunding no Gathering Fire stacks — was already written correctly and is genuinely the subtle interaction here.
Shadow Dash 18s at rank 1 falling to 10s at rank 5 is the entire step-up calculus.

edits.after: Mantra is usable from level 1 — open RQ Soulflare for a poke threat Shen cannot answer before Shadow Dash comes online at 3.

edits.after: Layered Inner Flame plus RQ poke, refunded by Gathering Fire, taxes him before Shadow Dash is ranked and its 18s cooldown shortens.

edits.before: Shen has no taunt range until E at 6, so levels 1-3 are your only safe window: open RQ Soulflare for a delayed damage zone and slow, then chase with Inner Flame (Q) to build a health lead before he can punish.
edits.after: Shen has no gap-closer until he ranks Shadow Dash, so levels 1-3 are your safest window: open RQ Soulflare for a delayed damage zone and slow, then chase with Inner Flame (Q) to build an early health lead.

edits.before: Shadow Dash (E) is a long taunt-dash that locks you for ~1.5s. If your Inspire (E) shield or Mantra is down when he hits it, he gets a free all-in, and his taunt comes back faster than your defensive cooldowns.
edits.after: Shadow Dash (E) is a 600-range taunt-dash on 18s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5. If your Inspire shield or Mantra is down when it lands he gets a free all-in, and it outpaces your 12s Focused Resolve.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your only clean window, so use them. Open with RQ Soulflare the moment Mantra is up — Shen has no way to close the gap before he gets Shadow Dash at 6, and the delayed Soulflare zone plus a follow-up Inner Flame (Q) forces him to eat chip he can only partly sustain through Ki Barrier. Stack Q poke at max range and let Gathering Fire refund your Mantra as your hits land, so you can rotate RQ again quickly. The trap is his W, Spirit's Refuge: never step into that zone to auto, because it blocks every basic attack — and blocked autos refund no Mantra and build no passive stacks.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your only clean window, so use them. Open with RQ Soulflare the moment Mantra is up — Shen has no way to close the gap until he ranks Shadow Dash, which starts on an 18s cooldown, and the delayed Soulflare zone plus a follow-up Inner Flame (Q) forces him to eat chip he can only partly sustain through Ki Barrier. Stack Q poke at max range and let Gathering Fire refund your Mantra as your hits land, so you can rotate RQ again quickly. The trap is his W, Spirit's Refuge: never step into that zone to auto, because it blocks every basic attack — and blocked autos refund no Mantra and build no passive stacks.

edits.before: This is where it slips. At 6, Shen's Shadow Dash taunt defines the lane — he dashes across the range gap you live behind and taunt-locks you for over a second, and if your Inspire shield or Mantra is on cooldown that taunt is a free all-in on your squishy frame. Don't throw Focused Resolve (W) to open a trade here, because the tether breaks if he dashes you out of range or behind terrain; instead hold it to root him after he has already burned Shadow Dash. Bait the dash by hovering just outside its range, then back off — once Shadow Dash is down he has no gap-closer left and you can resume Q poke safely until it returns.
edits.after: This is where it slips. Once Shadow Dash is ranked, his taunt defines the lane — he dashes across the range gap you live behind and taunt-locks you, and if your Inspire shield or Mantra is on cooldown that taunt is a free all-in on your squishy frame. Don't throw Focused Resolve (W) to open a trade here, because the tether breaks if he dashes you out of range or behind terrain; instead hold it to root him after he has already burned Shadow Dash. Bait the dash by hovering just outside its 600 range, then back off — for the next 18s he has no gap-closer at all and Q poke is free.

edits.before: You have no scaling 1v1 spike and Shen does — Ki Barrier shields sponge your Q chip, his tank items make your magic damage tickle, and Stand United (R) lets him influence the whole map while you fall off as a solo threat. Stop trying to 1v1 him; you won't win it. Pivot fully to utility: shield-and-speed a carry with Inspire, use RE for the AoE ripple shield to peel a fight, and roam to cash your early lead somewhere Shen isn't. If you didn't bank a health or plate lead before his first tank item, the lane is lost.
edits.after: You have no scaling 1v1 spike and Shen does — Ki Barrier sponges your Q chip, his tank items make your magic damage tickle, and Stand United (R) swings fights across the map. But that R is a channel: a Focused Resolve root cancels it outright, so watch for the cast and interrupt it. Stop trying to 1v1 him. Pivot to utility: shield-and-speed a carry with Inspire, RE to peel a fight, and roam to cash your lead somewhere Shen isn't. If you banked no lead before his first tank item, the lane is lost.
